root_cause.text: A copy-paste error in the `__audit_log_capset()` function caused the effective capability set to be assigned to both the effective and inheritable fields of the audit record, instead of assigning the inheritable capability set to the inheritable field.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows the fix on line 2789 of kernel/auditsc.c, changing `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_effective;` to `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_inheritable;`. This demonstrates that the inheritable field was incorrectly populated with `cap_effective` instead of `cap_inheritable`, causing audit records to report incorrect capability data for forensic and compliance analysis.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix audit logging of capability sets to correctly record inheritable capabilities instead of duplicating effective capabilities.
intent_record.what: Changed line 2789 from assigning `new->cap_effective` to `context->capset.cap.inheritable` to assigning `new->cap_inheritable` instead.
intent_record.how: This fixes the audit log to correctly record the inheritable capability set from the new credentials. Previously, the inheritable field was being populated with the effective capability set (a duplicate), masking the actual inheritable capabilities in audit records.

The fix ensures the inheritable capability set is properly assigned to the inheritable field.
